newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BOURSE INTEREST RETURNS WITH MODERATE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: BOURSE INTEREST RETURNS WITH MODERATE TRADE.

text.p: Local investors were returning
to the Estonian bourse with renewed buying interest on Monday
morning and the market was expected to firm by the end of the
session, dealers said.
Trade volume on the main list at 0900GMT was 22.2 million
kroons with the Talse online index 0.19 percent higher at
"There cetrainly seems to be more courage and buying
interest from local investors this morning compared to the past
weeks," one dealer said.
"The Talse should end about one percent higher," he added.
Hoiupank was the most active stock on registered trade of
3.8 million kroons for a spread of 130.60/131.50 kroons
compared to Friday's close of 129.78 kroons
Uhispank was lower on a bid ask of 50.15/50.50
kroons in trade of 3.5 million kroons.
"Uhispank and Tallinna Pank ended their dispute
this morning with a handshake and added to the market's
confidence this morning," another dealer said.
The two banks issued a joint statement on Monday morning
saying that they will stop their very public comments about
each other's banking operations.
The free market turned over 7.2 million kroons of shares
with the Rakvere meat plant the most active with 6.2
million kroons traded.
Rakvere fell slightly for a spread of 15.75/15.85 kroons
versus 16.00 kroons on Friday.
"No one is sure what the real situation is with Rakvere and
investors are confused over how much the plant paid for the
Riga factory," one trader said.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn Newsroom, +372 630 8400,
reuters@reuters.ee
